verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that CrewAI's YAML configuration lets users version-control agent settings. That is a user-side workaround: versioning happens in an external tool like git, not in a product-native automation versioning, review, or rollback feature. Nothing in the pack documents version history, review or approval workflows, or rollback for crews, flows, or deployed automations in the open-source framework or AMP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
